about.title: About {{appName}}
about.lead: {{appName}} is a screenwriting app that runs entirely in your browser.
about.body: Write in industry-standard screenplay format as you type, with a print-accurate Pages view, AI-assisted review and polish, and import/export to Fountain, Final Draft (FDX) and Fade In. Your work is saved offline first and synced when you're online, so a shaky connection never costs you a scene.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.lead: Questions, feedback or a bug to report — we'd like to hear it.

whatToInclude.title: What to include
items: What you were trying to do, and what happened instead
The project or document name, if it's specific to one
Your browser and operating system

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.body: Create a project, then a document from a template (screenplay, stage play, TV, and more). The editor opens straight into the Edit view with one empty scene heading, ready to type.

formatting.title: Formatting screenplay elements
formatting.body: As you type, Tab and Cmd+number cycle an element between Scene Heading, Action, Character, Parenthetical, Dialogue and Transition. Pasting in multi-line text auto-tags each line with its likely role (scene heading, character, dialogue, action, and so on) so you rarely have to set styles by hand at all — it's not perfect on text with no blank lines between elements (there's no way to tell dialogue from the action that follows without one), so double-check pasted text and fix up any line with Tab or Cmd+number.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: The shortcuts that come up most while writing:

importExport.title: Import and export
importExport.body: Import a Fountain, Final Draft (.fdx) or Fade In (.fadein) script from the documents list — by picker or by dropping the file. A conversion report calls out anything lost or changed in the conversion. Export any open document back out to those formats, plus JSON, or print it to PDF from the Pages view.

structure.title: Structure and navigation
structure.body: The Scenes toggle in the editor's top bar opens a Navigator listing every scene, and a Cards view for a corkboard-style overview. Clicking a scene jumps the editor's caret straight to its heading.

titlePage.title: Title page and page setup
titlePage.body: The Title page and Page setup buttons in the editor's top bar cover title page fields, headers and footers, page numbering, scene numbering, and continueds ("(MORE)"/"(CONT'D)").

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.body: The Snapshots panel lets you save a named point in a document's history, reopen it read-only, or fork it into a new document — a lightweight alternative to exporting a backup copy by hand.

resources.title: Resources
resources.lead: Places to find scripts worth importing, and to learn the screenplay format itself.

simplyScripts.title: Simply Scripts
simplyScripts.body: A large, free archive of produced and spec screenplays, many in plain text you can paste straight in.

imsdb.title: Internet Movie Script Database
imsdb.body: Screenplays for produced films, browsable by title or genre.

fountainSpec.title: Fountain syntax
fountainSpec.body: The plain-text screenplay format this app's importer and smart paste are built around.

wgaFormatting.title: Screenwriting 101 (WGA)
wgaFormatting.body: The Writers Guild of America's primer on industry-standard screenplay format.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to {{appName}}. This policy explains what information we collect when you use the app, and how we use and protect it.

youProvide.title: Information you provide
items: Account information (email address, via Google sign-in)
The screenplays and projects you create
Settings and preferences

automatic.title: Information collected automatically
items: Device and browser information
IP address
Basic usage and error logs, to keep the app working

usage.title: How we use your information
usage.description: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide and improve the editor and its features
Sync your documents between your devices
Respond to support requests
Keep the service secure and working correctly

ai.title: AI features
ai.content: The AI review and polish features send the relevant scene or document text to our AI provider to generate a coverage report or polish suggestions. That text is used only to generate the response to your request; it is not used to train models.

storage.title: Local storage
storage.content: The app keeps an offline copy of your open documents in your browser's IndexedDB storage, so you can keep working without a connection. This copy stays on your device and syncs with our servers once you're back online.

sharing.title: Information sharing
sharing.description: We do not sell your information. We may share it:
items: With service providers who help us run the app (hosting, AI processing)
When required by law
With your consent

retention.title: Data retention
retention.content: We keep your account and document data for as long as your account is active. You can delete a project or document at any time; deleting your account removes the rest.

rights.title: Your rights
items: Access the information we hold about you
Correct inaccurate information
Request deletion of your account and data
Export your screenplays (Fountain, FDX or JSON) at any time

children.title: Children's privacy
children.content: This service is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from them.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.content: We may update this policy from time to time. We'll post the updated policy here and update the "last updated" date above.
